subject: POC kickoff & weekly check-ins — Acme Industries (post-call recap)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acme.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC kickoff & weekly check-ins — Acme Industries (post-call recap)

Hi Samantha — great to meet earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps from today's discovery: 

Summary of needs:
- Evaluate Redwood inference runtime for real-time customer support generation (latency <= 150ms p95 at expected QPS).
- Validate data isolation and VPC connectivity for sensitive logs.
- Measure cost per 1k QPS-equivalent tokens and assess batching/kv-cache settings.

Proposed success criteria (high-level):
1) Avg latency p95 <= 150ms for 512 token context during peak test load.
2) No PII leakage in outputs per our redaction tests.
3) Integration demonstrates model switch fallback (gpt-3.1 -> gpt-3.1-quant) with <5% error delta on quality eval.
4) SLO: 99.5% availability during scheduled test window.

POC timeline (proposal):
- Week 0 (kickoff): align stakeholders, confirm infra access and dataset.
- Weeks 1-3 (trial): Redwood deploys dedicated trial environment + run throughput/latency tests.
- Weekly check-ins (30 min) every Wed 10am PT.
- Final readout week 4: performance + quality + cost summary.

Ownership:
- Redwood: Marissa (overall), Dev (tech lead, infra & integration), Neha (customer success & instrumentation).
- Acme: Samantha (project sponsor), Ravi (infra lead), John (NLP SME).

Immediate asks:
1) Confirm stakeholders and preferred kickoff date/time (this week or early next).
2) Approve proposed success criteria or share edits.
3) Share minimal dataset and VPN/KMS contact for access.

I've attached a draft POC plan (POC-Plan-Acme-v1.pdf) and a draft SOW to accelerate contracting.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this scheduled.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Attachment: POC-Plan-Acme-v1.pdf

Thanks Marissa — this is super helpful. A few notes from our side: 

- Stakeholders confirmed: Samantha (sponsor), Ravi (infra), John (NLP), plus Livia Chen (privacy counsel) — I'll loop Livia into the security questionnaire thread separately.
- Success criteria: agree with latency and availability targets. For the quality delta we prefer a stricter threshold: allow up to 3% delta on top-line precision/recall for our main prompt set. Can Redwood include the evaluation harness we discussed?
- Timeline: we prefer kickoff next Tuesday (Mar 9) rather than this week — Ravi is on leave this week. Does that work?

Access: Ravi will send VPN details and point-of-contact for KMS next week. We can provide a 40k utterance evaluation set (anonymized) and a smaller 2k prompt set for iterative QA.

I'll review the SOW and get back on any redlines. Happy to do the weekly check-ins Wed 10am PT — that works for our team.

Samantha
Director, Product — Acme Industries

- Leakage: zero PII hits on the provided 40k anonymized dataset (Redwood will run redaction & detection checks).
- Quality: <= 3% top-line precision/recall delta between baseline and Redwood-backed responses on 2k eval set.
- Availability: 99.5% during scheduled tests.
\Proposed Milestones (owners):

- Final readout (Mar 25) — joint readout, deliverables: performance report, cost estimate, recommendations (Marissa + Neha lead).
\Weekly check-ins: Wednesdays 10am PT starting Mar 10 (calendar invite to follow).
\Action items for Acme before kickoff:
1) VPN/KMS contact + access window (Ravi).
2) Upload anonymized 40k utterance dataset to shared Drive link: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3cPOCPlan (or share alternate).
3) Confirm any compliance constraints Livia wants us to test.
\I've uploaded the POC plan to the Drive and attached the PDF here. I'll also push a SOW draft to DocuSign for signature to speed onboarding (link below).
\Thanks — I'll send a calendar invite for Mar 9 kickoff and the weekly check-ins.
\Best,
Marissa
